tagline: Global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of branded home improvement and building products.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net revenue is the primary indicator of the company's financial performance, reflecting its ability to generate sales in its home improvement and building products sector.
company_description: Masco Corporation provides home improvement and building products in North America, Europe, and internationally. The company's Plumbing Products segment offers faucets, showerheads, handheld showers, valves, bath hardware and accessories, bathing units, shower bases and enclosures, shower drains, steam shower systems, water filtration systems, and sinks and kitchen accessories; acrylic tubs, bath and shower enclosures, and shower bases and trays; spas, exercise pools, and aquatic fitness systems and saunas; brass, copper, and composite plumbing system component and other non-decorative plumbing products; water products; and thermoplastic products, extruded plastic profiles, and specialized fabrication products, as well as PEX tubing products. This segment provides its products under the DELTA, BRIZO, PEERLESS, HANSGROHE, AXOR, KRAUS, NEWPORT BRASS, GINGER, WALTEC, BRISTAN, HERITAGE, MIROLIN, HOT SPRING, CALDERA, FREEFLOW SPAS, FANTASY SPAS, AQUATERRA, LIFESMART, ENDLESS POOLS, TYLO, FINNLEO, HELO, BRASSCRAFT, PLUMBSHOP, and MASTER PLUMBER brands, as well as under private label to home center and online retailers, mass merchandisers, wholesalers and distributors, plumbers, building

kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of products and services.
kpis.description: Net revenue decreased 3% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to a decline in sales volume.
kpis.signal: Overall sales decline, impacted by volume and currency effects.

kpis.explanation: Difference between net revenue and cost of sales, indicating direct product profitability.
kpis.description: Gross margin decreased by 0.8 percentage points in 2025, impacted by raw material costs, tariffs and lower sales volumes.
kpis.signal: Gross margin declined, affected by raw material costs and volume decreases.

kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by net revenue, measuring the profitability of core operations.
kpis.description: Operating margin decreased by 0.9 percentage points in 2025, affected by lower gross margin and an impairment charge.
kpis.signal: Operating margin declined, reflecting gross margin pressure and exceptional charges.

kpis.explanation: Total profit after deducting all expenses, including taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Net income decreased 1% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to lower gross profit.
kpis.signal: Slight net income decline, despite lower expenses.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of plumbing products.
kpis.description: The plumbing products segment saw sales increase 3% in 2025, driven by higher selling prices.
kpis.signal: Moderate plumbing products sales growth, driven by pricing.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of decorative and architectural products.
kpis.description: The decorative architectural products segment experienced a 14% decline in sales in 2025, primarily due to lower volume and the divestiture of the Kichler business.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in decorative products sales, impacted by volume and a divestiture.

kpis.explanation: Costs related to sales, marketing, administration and general expenses.
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses decreased 3% in 2025, notably due to the divestiture of the Kichler business.
kpis.signal: SG&A expenses declined, partially due to business divestiture.

kpis.explanation: Amount invested in acquiring or upgrading physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures for 2025 totaled $156 million, compared to $168 million for 2024. The decrease reflects the completion of capacity expansion investments in 2024.
kpis.signal: Capital expenditures decreased in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to reduced capacity investments.

kpis.description: Annual consolidated revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported 10-K fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of $7.562B for the latest year.

kpis.description: Annual consolidated net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported 10-K fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.81B for the latest year.

kpis.explanation: Number of shares repurchased by the company to reduce outstanding shares.
kpis.description: In 2025, the company repurchased approximately 8.5 million shares for approximately $576 million, demonstrating a commitment to returning capital to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Continued shareholder value return through share repurchases.

kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in the quarterly dividend paid to shareholders.
kpis.description: The quarterly dividend was increased by approximately 7% in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting confidence in cash flow generation.
kpis.signal: Dividend increase, a sign of confidence in future performance.

kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year.
Annual total: dividends paid + share repurchases.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + repurchases (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.explanation: Share of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

Net income divided by the average number of diluted shares over the fiscal year. Allows visualization of the company's ability to generate earnings per share, the basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Economic Risk and Business Cycles
risks.summary: The company is exposed to economic risks that impact residential renovation and new construction spending, its primary growth drivers.
risks.score_rationale: The company is impacted by economic factors such as consumer confidence, debt and income levels, and interest rates. Business cycles directly affect residential renovation and new construction. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supplier Dependence and Supply Chain
risks.summary: The company is vulnerable to supply chain risks, such as delivery delays, price increases and tariff exposure.
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its suppliers for raw materials, components and finished products. Raw material cost increases and tariffs impacted margins in 2025. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Currency Risk
risks.summary: The company is impacted by exchange rate fluctuations, which affect its financial performance and margins globally.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to currency risks due to its international operations. Currency effects reduced net sales by $45 million in 2025. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Labor Shortage Risk
risks.summary: The company is vulnerable to risks related to labor shortages and availability of skilled workers, which may impact its ability to execute its strategies.
risks.score_rationale: The company must attract, develop and retain talented employees to succeed. Availability of skilled workers for repairs and renovations is mentioned as a key factor. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intense Competition Risk
risks.summary: The company must maintain its strong brands and competitive positioning against established and emerging rivals.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector with numerous local and international players. (default score, to be refined)
